title: Indifferentiability of the Swap-or-Not Cipher
summary: The swap-or-not cipher has strong-PRP security, but whether it is indifferentiable from a random permutation remains open.

formal_statement.body: The swap-or-not cipher has established strong pseudorandom-permutation (strong-PRP) security, but the stronger question of whether this cipher is indifferentiable from a random permutation remains unresolved; the open task is to establish this indifferentiability result or to provide a refutation.

scope.domain: Security analysis of the swap-or-not block cipher under strong-PRP and indifferentiability notions.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Establish that the swap-or-not cipher is indifferentiable from a random permutation, or refute that property.

citations.label: An Enciphering Scheme Based on a Card Shuffle

progress.summary: The paper presents strong-PRP security as the established boundary and explicitly leaves indifferentiability from a random permutation open.
